title: Narrow workflow permissions and verify action references
prompt: A workflow grants contents: write and pull-requests: write to every job and references third-party actions only by mutable tags. Without editing files, what should a security review recommend about token scope and action references?
rubric: The response scopes GITHUB_TOKEN permissions to the minimum needed, preferably at job level where appropriate.
It recommends verifying and pinning third-party action references to immutable full commit SHAs when policy or threat model requires it.
It does not invent a current action version or claim an unverified tag is secure.
acceptance: The response recommends least privilege and verified immutable action references without asserting an unverified release version.
